_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

nodes.name: Susa
nodes.label: Susa
nodes.description: Ancient capital of Elam and later Achaemenid winter capital, one of oldest continuously inhabited cities.

nodes.name: Ecbatana (Hamadan)
nodes.label: Ecbatana
nodes.description: Capital of the Median Empire and summer residence of Achaemenid and later Persian kings.

nodes.name: Jiroft Archaeological Site
nodes.label: Jiroft
nodes.description: Bronze Age urban center revealing sophisticated early Iranian civilization.

nodes.name: Persepolis
nodes.label: Persepolis
nodes.description: Ceremonial capital of Achaemenid Empire, UNESCO World Heritage site with monumental ruins.

nodes.name: Pasargadae
nodes.label: Pasargadae
nodes.description: First capital of Achaemenid Empire founded by Cyrus the Great, containing his tomb.

nodes.name: Ctesiphon
nodes.label: Ctesiphon
nodes.description: Sasanian imperial capital on the Tigris, featuring the great Taq Kasra arch.

nodes.name: Alamut Fortress
nodes.label: Alamut Fortress
nodes.description: Mountain stronghold of Ismaili Nizaris (Assassins) in the Alborz mountains.

nodes.name: Nishapur
nodes.label: Nishapur
nodes.description: Major center of learning and ceramics production, birthplace of Omar Khayyam.

nodes.name: Sultaniyya
nodes.label: Sultaniyya
nodes.description: Ilkhanid capital featuring the Mausoleum of Öljaitü, largest brick dome in world.

nodes.name: Isfahan (Safavid Capital)
nodes.label: Isfahan
nodes.description: Safavid capital rebuilt by Shah Abbas I, called 'half the world' for its magnificence.

nodes.name: Naqsh-e Jahan Square
nodes.label: Naqsh-e Jahan Square
nodes.description: Monumental public square in Isfahan, UNESCO World Heritage site, center of Safavid power.

nodes.name: Ardabil Shrine
nodes.label: Ardabil Shrine
nodes.description: Shrine of Sheikh Safi al-Din, spiritual ancestor of Safavid dynasty.

nodes.name: Tehran
nodes.label: Tehran
nodes.description: Capital of Iran since Qajar era, transformed into modern metropolis under Pahlavis.

nodes.name: Golestan Palace
nodes.label: Golestan Palace
nodes.description: Qajar royal palace complex in Tehran, UNESCO World Heritage site.

nodes.name: Abadan Refinery
nodes.label: Abadan Refinery
nodes.description: Once world's largest oil refinery, center of Anglo-Iranian oil operations.

nodes.name: Tehran (Contemporary)
nodes.label: Tehran
nodes.description: Capital of the Islamic Republic, political and cultural center of modern Iran.

nodes.name: Qom
nodes.label: Qom
nodes.description: Holy city and center of Shia scholarship, home to major seminaries and shrines.

nodes.name: Mashhad
nodes.label: Mashhad
nodes.description: Iran's holiest city, site of Imam Reza shrine attracting millions of pilgrims annually.
